newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK STEEL HOLDS 20 PCT IN CZECH TRINEC.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK STEEL HOLDS 20 PCT IN CZECH TRINEC.

text.p: VSZ a.s. Slovakia's largest steel producer confirmed on Monday it had bought a 20 percent stake in Czech steel producer Trinecke Zelezarny.
"We have declared a strategy to build a strong multi-national company in central Europe and the buy into Trinec is a part of this strategy," Jan Seno, VSZ Vice-President for Finance told Reuters.
Seno said VSZ had bought the stake from a major Trinec shareholder whom he declined to name.
Under an earlier agreement BSZ and Trinec agreed to buy into each other, with the plan calling for VSZ to buy 20 percent of Trinec and Trinec taking a 10 percent stake in VSZ.
But Seno said Trinec had waived its right and had not bought any stake in VSZ.
Earlier this year VSZ said it was also interested in taking a stake in Czech engineering concern Skoda a.s. but Seno said this was now no longer a topical issue.
"The purchase of a stake in Skoda is not a completely dead issue but it definitely not on our current agenda," Seno said.
